proposed_description: Exclamative use of che (+ bare noun/adjective), come (+ verb), and quanto (agreeing, quantity): Che bello!, Come sei gentile!, Quante storie! Same words as the interrogatives in a non-question function.

proposed_attributes.canonical_example: Che bello! / Come sei gentile! / Quante storie!

rationale: Ruling B (Smith 2026-08-03): exclamatives 'should be in somewhere'; same words, non-question function, so interrogatives is the natural host. 5 grammar + 2 translation authored against this id, held in data/_pending_interrogatives_exclamatives.json pending mint.
